response.explanation: The processes are created via mp_context = get_context("spawn"), so they are SpawnProcess instances. SpawnProcess subclasses BaseProcess, not multiprocessing.context.Process (which is what multiprocessing.Process refers to), so isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) is False. The old code called self.process.kill() unconditionally. Now, when a flusher is unhealthy ("hang" cause, process still alive), kill() is skipped and _create_process_for_shards starts a second process for the same shards. The same check in join() skips terminate().
response.title: Hung flusher processes are never killed: isinstance check against multiprocessing.Process fails for SpawnProcess
